raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 16
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced an auto-generated DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” answer stating that Charles d’Orléans’s paternal grandfather was Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon, Duke of Penthièvre. This is incorrect, likely due to confusing the source of the Penthièvre title with the paternal lineage. The correct paternal grandfather is Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans (Philippe Égalité). Although the Planner did not adopt this misinformation, this step introduced the erroneous claim into the workflow.
